## v1.11.0 — 2026-03-23

Version 1.11.0 introduces significant security hardening with JWT, CORS, and XSS improvements, adds Railway deployment support, refactors API routes for better modularity, upgrades default AI models across providers, and includes comprehensive CI/CD fixes with pnpm v10 migration and enhanced Docker builds.

### ⚠️ Breaking Changes

- Remove OpenClaw provider integration for enhanced security

### ✨ Features

- Add Railway deployment configuration with dashboard URL support for streamlined cloud deployment
- Upgrade Gemini model to 2.5-flash for improved performance and capabilities
- Add 13 new test cases covering deployment configuration and OAuth redirect functionality

### 🔧 Improvements

- Implement comprehensive security audit with hardened JWT validation, CORS policies, XSS protection, atomic writes, enhanced rate limiting, and secure environment variable handling
- Refactor API architecture by extracting route modules and consolidating shared utilities and billing webhooks
- Make table of contents collapsible on mobile devices for privacy and terms pages to improve mobile UX

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Display API-not-deployed banner on dashboard instead of showing 404 login error
- Update all CI workflows from pnpm v9 to v10 and pin pnpm@10.32.1 in Dockerfile and package.json
- Fix Docker build process by copying .npmrc for pnpm configuration and excluding action bundle from production builds
- Remove pnpm version specification from CI workflows to use packageManager field instead
- Fix VERSION constant definition and resolve mobile footer display issues

### 🧹 Chores

- Upgrade default Anthropic model to Claude Sonnet 4.6 for enhanced AI capabilities
- Update default Ollama model from llama3.1 to llama3.3 for latest model improvements
- Add comprehensive release notes documentation for OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, and Gemini providers across all v1.x versions

## v1.11.0 — 2026-03-23

This release focuses on significant security hardening, including deep dive audits for JWT, CORS, XSS, and environment variables, alongside the removal of the OpenClaw provider for security reasons. It introduces new deployment capabilities for Railway and upgrades several default AI models, such as Gemini to 2.5-flash, Anthropic to Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Ollama to llama3.3. Additionally, the release includes substantial API refactoring, numerous Docker and CI build fixes, and various UI improvements.

### ⚠️ Breaking Changes

- Remove the OpenClaw provider due to security concerns.

### ✨ Features

- Add Railway deployment configuration and dashboard URL support.
- Upgrade the Gemini model to 2.5-flash.

### 🔧 Improvements

- Refactor the API by extracting route modules and consolidating shared utilities and billing webhooks.
- Implement deep dive security audit hardening for JWT, CORS, XSS, atomic writes, rate limiting, and environment variables.
- Conduct a general audit, fixing the VERSION constant, mobile footer, minor security issues, and deduplicating code.
- Upgrade the default Anthropic model to Claude Sonnet 4.6 and the default Ollama model from llama3.1 to llama3.3.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Resolve CI workflow issues related to pnpm versioning, updating pnpm from v9 to v10 and removing explicit version pinning from workflows.
- Fix Docker build issues by copying `.npmrc` into the production stage, skipping action bundles, and pinning pnpm@10.32.1 in the Dockerfile and `package.json`.
- Correctly display an API-not-deployed banner on the dashboard instead of a 404 login page.
- Make the Table of Contents collapsible on mobile for privacy and terms pages.

### 🧹 Chores

- Add 13 new tests for deployment configuration and OAuth redirects.
- Generate and add release notes for OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, and Gemini for all v1.x tags.

### Contributors

@mttaylor, @github-actions[bot]
